summary: Darwin Notify is a system-wide, name-keyed notification facility with integer tokens, state values and kernel-level delivery. BifrOSt has no equivalent: the nearest app-facing counterpart is the Foundation-style DistributedNotificationCenter, which relays string-named broadcasts between running apps through the shell. System event names (time zone, mounts, clock, network) are not broadcast to apps by name.

features.note: Cross-app broadcast relayed by the shell (ToShell::DistPost). Headless tests: a_distributed_post_reaches_local_observers_and_is_queued_for_the_shell_sorted, a_process_local_distributed_post_sends_nothing_to_the_shell, notify_bus_calls_go_to_the_notify_bus_service_with_their_method. Only between BifrOSt apps, string names, string user_info capped at 32 entries; no system-wide Darwin names. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Registering a handler for a name (notify_register_dispatch)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs (DistributedNotificationCenter::add_observer, NotificationCenter::add_observer); springboard/sdk/src/notify_bus.rs (register, Mode); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/services/notify_bus.rs (notified event)
features.note: Observers run on the main thread and take an optional object filter. Headless tests: an_observer_hears_its_name_and_its_object_only, an_observer_without_an_object_hears_every_object_and_gets_the_user_info. Observer closures are tied to the main thread; there is no queue argument. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/notify_center.rs (NotifyCenter::register, check, post); springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; springboard/sdk/src/notify_bus.rs (check); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/notify_bus.rs (register mode poll, check)
features.note: A poll token is marked on each post and the mark is cleared by check. Headless tests: post_marks_every_live_token_on_the_name_and_counts_them, check_clears_the_pending_mark, a_poll_token_does_not_queue_signals. The shell offers poll mode through the notify bus check call. Verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 5 (theme-02, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No POSIX signal delivery for notifications.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (theme-20, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. fswatch exposes an fd for file-system events only; there is no fd for named notifications.
Mach ports are Apple-kernel IPC; Linux build has no equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/notify_center.rs (cancel, suspend, resume, is_valid); springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs (ObserverToken drop removes observer); springboard/sdk/src/notify_bus.rs (suspend, resume, cancel, valid); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/notify_bus.rs (cancel, suspend, resume, valid)
features.note: Cancelling removes a token, suspending skips posts while resume restarts delivery, and is_valid answers for a live token. Headless tests: cancelled_tokens_stop_receiving_posts, suspended_tokens_miss_posts_and_resume_restarts_delivery, an_observer_hears_its_name_and_its_object_only (dropping the token removes the observer). The in-process observer token has drop only, not suspend or resume. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/notify_center.rs (NotifyCenter::set_state, state); springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; springboard/sdk/src/notify_bus.rs (set_state, state); wired: springboard/src/shell/services/notify_bus.rs (set_state, state)
features.note: A 64-bit state value per name, shared by every token on it, defaults to zero. Headless test: name_state_defaults_to_zero_and_keeps_the_last_value_set. The SDK refuses set_state for system names. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: notify_post delivery when target not running
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-09, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. An app that is not running misses the post, equal to Apple's drop behaviour, with no option to hold it.

features.feature: System event names (kNotifyTimeZoneChange, kNotifyClockSet, kNotifyVFSMount, kNotifyVFSUnmount, kNotifyVFSLowDiskSpace, kNotifySCNetworkChange, kNotifySCHostNameChange, kNotifyDSCacheInvalidation*, kNotifyASLDBUpdate)
features.note: The eleven system names are defined in the core model under the system namespace (system_event_names_are_the_system_namespace_and_include_the_clock_and_volume_events). Only the appearance, screen lock and network changes are posted by the shell; there is no broadcast for time zone, clock, mount, disk-space, host-name or cache changes under these names. Verify on Midget for parity.
Return codes of the Darwin C API; not applicable to the BifrOSt SDK.

gaps: No system-wide named notifications from the kernel or system services (time zone, clock, mount, network, disk space) to apps.
No notify_check, notify_register_signal, notify_set_state or notify_get_state equivalents.
No suspend or resume of observers, and no hold-for-later delivery to apps that are not running.
Observers always run on the main thread; no caller-chosen dispatch queue.
Broadcast payloads are string to string with a 32-entry and 1024-character cap per value.
